记得.zh: 虽然很久没见，但我还记得你。
记得.en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, I still remember you.
Remember to lock the door before you leave.

药.zh: 这种药一天吃三次，饭后吃。
药.en: This medicine is taken three times a day after meals.

药.zh: 因为感冒了，所以我得去买点药。
药.en: Because I caught a cold, I need to buy some medicine.
The medicine is too bitter, I don't want to drink it.
The doctor prescribed me new medicine.

身体.zh: 我的身体最近有点不舒服。
身体.en: My body hasn't been feeling well lately.

身体.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但要照顾好身体。
身体.en: Although work is busy, you need to take care of your health.
More exercise is good for the body.

身体.zh: 她身体很健康，从来不生病。
身体.en: She is very healthy and never gets sick.

想到.zh: 我没想到会在这里见到你。
想到.en: I didn't think I'd see you here.

想到.zh: 突然想到一件事，我得打个电话。
想到.en: Suddenly thought of something, I need to make a call.

想到.zh: 一看到这张照片，我就想到过去的时光。
想到.en: As soon as I see this photo, I think of the past times.
Have you thought of a solution?
She came up with a good idea.

包.en: I wrapped up all the books.

包.zh: 因为东西太多，我需要一个大包。
包.en: Because there are too many things, I need a big bag.

包.zh: 她每天上班都背一个黑包。
包.en: She carries a black bag to work every day.

那样.zh: 如果你那样说，她会生气的。
那样.en: If you say it that way, she will get angry.

那样.zh: 虽然那样很方便，但不太安全。
那样.en: Although that way is very convenient, it's not very safe.
In that case, I won't go.
How did he become like that?

往.en: Go forward a bit and you'll arrive.

往.zh: 如果你一直往南走，会看到一条河。
往.en: If you keep walking south, you'll see a river.
The train is heading to Beijing.

楼.zh: 因为电梯坏了，我们只能爬楼。
楼.en: Because the elevator is broken, we have to climb the stairs.
His home is on the fifth floor.
The teaching building is next to the library.

飞.zh: 飞机在天空中飞得很高。
飞.en: The airplane flies very high in the sky.

飞.zh: 如果我有一双翅膀，我也想飞。
飞.en: If I had wings, I would want to fly too.

介绍.zh: 我先介绍一下，然后你再问问题。
介绍.en: I'll introduce first, then you can ask questions.

介绍.zh: 你能给我介绍一下你的工作吗？
介绍.en: Can you tell me about your job?
They introduced us and we got to know each other.

介绍.zh: 这个朋友是我妈妈介绍的，所以我很信任他。
介绍.en: This friend was introduced by my mom, so I trust him a lot.

出去.en: I need to go out for a bit.
It's raining outside, don't go out.

出去.zh: 如果你出去的话，记得带钥匙。
出去.en: If you go out, remember to bring the key.

出去.zh: 我们出去吃晚饭吧，我不想做饭。
出去.en: Let's go out for dinner, I don't want to cook.
He just went out to buy things.

眼睛.zh: 我眼睛有点疼，可能是看手机太久了。
眼睛.en: My eyes hurt a bit, probably from looking at the phone too long.

眼睛.zh: 虽然她眼睛不大，但是很有神。
眼睛.en: Although her eyes aren't big, they are very lively.

眼睛.zh: 你要保护好眼睛，少看电脑。
眼睛.en: You need to protect your eyes, use the computer less.

做到.zh: 只要你努力，就能做到你想做的事。
做到.en: As long as you work hard, you can achieve what you want.

做到.zh: 他不仅做到了，而且还做得很好。
做到.en: He not only achieved it, but also did it very well.
If you say it, you have to do it.

近.zh: 这个超市离我家很近，走路只要五分钟。
近.en: This supermarket is near my home, only five minutes on foot.

近.zh: 因为离公司近，所以我每天走路上班。
近.en: Because it's near the company, I walk to work every day.

近.zh: 最近的车站在前面右转。
近.en: The nearest station is turn right ahead.

下去.zh: 你不能一直这样下去，要改变。
下去.en: You can't keep on like this, you need to change.

下去.zh: 如果坚持下去，你一定会成功。
下去.en: If you persist, you will definitely succeed.

下去.zh: 电梯坏了，我们走下去吧。
下去.en: The elevator is broken, let's walk down.

离.zh: 我家离学校只有两公里。
离.en: My home is only two kilometers from school.

离.zh: 因为离机场很远，所以我们要早点出发。
离.en: Because it's far from the airport, we need to leave early.

离.zh: 他离手机太近了，对眼睛不好。
离.en: He is too close to the phone, bad for eyes.
We are not far from success.

经常.en: I often go to the library.

经常.zh: 他经常加班，周末也不休息。
经常.en: He often works overtime, even on weekends no rest.

经常.zh: 虽然我们经常见面，但是不太聊天。
经常.en: Although we often meet, we don't chat much.

经常.zh: 你经常运动吗？对身体好。
经常.en: Do you often exercise? Good for health.

票.zh: 电影票卖完了，我们明天再看吧。
票.en: Movie tickets sold out, let's watch tomorrow.

票.zh: 如果你有票，就可以进去。
票.en: If you have a ticket, you can go in.

票.zh: 这张票是朋友送的，我自己没花钱。
票.en: This ticket was given by a friend, I didn't pay.

床.zh: 我每天早上都不想起床。
床.en: Every morning I don't want to get up.

床.zh: 虽然床很小，但是睡得很香。
床.en: Although the bed is small, I sleep soundly.

床.zh: 他吃完饭就躺在床上玩手机。
床.en: After eating, he lies on bed playing with phone.

床.zh: 孩子睡在上下铺的床上。
床.en: The child sleeps on a bunk bed.

越来越.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

越来越.zh: 因为工作越来越忙，我很少运动了。
越来越.en: Because work is getting busier and busier, I rarely exercise.

越来越.zh: 他越来越喜欢学习中文了。
越来越.en: He likes learning Chinese more and more.

越来越.zh: 这个问题越来越复杂，我们得好好想想。
越来越.en: This problem is becoming more and more complicated; we need to think carefully.

越来越.zh: 她的中文说得越来越流利了。
越来越.en: Her Chinese is becoming more and more fluent.

教.zh: 爸爸教了我很多做人的道理。
教.en: Dad taught me a lot about how to behave.

教.zh: 你能不能教我怎么用这个软件？
教.en: Can you teach me how to use this software?

教.zh: 他在一所小学教数学和体育。
教.en: He teaches math and physical education at an elementary school.

教.zh: 谢谢老师耐心地教我们写汉字。
教.en: Thank you, teacher, for patiently teaching us to write Chinese characters.

意思.en: What do you mean by that?

意思.zh: 这个电影很有意思，大家都喜欢看。
意思.en: This movie is very interesting; everyone likes to watch it.

意思.zh: 我不太明白这句话的意思。
意思.en: I don't quite understand the meaning of this sentence.

意思.zh: 他送礼物给你，是不是有什么意思？
意思.en: He gave you a gift; does it mean something?

意思.zh: 虽然有点贵，但我觉得这个礼物很有意思。
意思.en: Although a bit expensive, I think this gift is very interesting.

忘.en: I forgot to bring my keys.
Don't forget what I told you.

忘.zh: 他忘了今天是妈妈的生日。
忘.en: He forgot that today is Mom's birthday.

忘.zh: 走的时候别忘了关灯和空调。
忘.en: Don't forget to turn off the lights and air conditioner when you leave.

忘.zh: 我本来想买牛奶，结果一到超市就忘了。
忘.en: I originally wanted to buy milk, but as soon as I got to the supermarket I forgot.

不少.en: Quite a few people came today.

不少.zh: 他花了不少时间才做完这件事。
不少.en: He spent quite a lot of time finishing this task.

不少.zh: 这个城市有不少好玩的地方。
不少.en: This city has quite a few fun places.

不少.zh: 虽然工资不高，但每个月也能存不少钱。
不少.en: Although the salary isn't high, I can still save quite a bit of money each month.

不少.zh: 经过不少努力，他终于成功了。
不少.en: After quite a lot of effort, he finally succeeded.

就要.en: The train is about to leave.

就要.zh: 等了一个小时，他们就要到了。
就要.en: After waiting an hour, they are about to arrive.

就要.zh: 电影就要开始了，我们快进去吧。
就要.en: The movie is about to start; let's go in quickly.

就要.zh: 春天就要来了，天气会慢慢变暖。
就要.en: Spring is about to come; the weather will gradually warm up.

就要.zh: 如果再不出发，我们就要迟到了。
就要.en: If we don't leave now, we are going to be late.

画.zh: 我小时候很喜欢画小猫小狗。
画.en: When I was a child, I really liked drawing cats and dogs.

画.zh: 这幅画是你画的吗？真好看！
画.en: Did you draw this painting? It's really beautiful!

画.zh: 他花了一个下午画完这张草图。
画.en: He spent an afternoon finishing this sketch.

画.zh: 孩子用彩色笔在纸上画了一个太阳。
画.en: The child drew a sun on the paper with colored pens.

运动.zh: 运动对身体很好，你也要多运动。
运动.en: Exercise is very good for your health; you should also exercise more.
What sport do you like best?

运动.zh: 周末我们一起去运动吧，打篮球怎么样？
运动.en: Let's go exercise together on the weekend; how about playing basketball?

运动.zh: 因为平时工作很忙，他只有周末才有时间运动。
运动.en: Because he is usually very busy with work, he only has time to exercise on weekends.

回去.zh: 明天我要回去老家看看父母。
回去.en: Tomorrow I'm going back to my hometown to visit my parents.

回去.zh: 电影已经看完了，我们回去吧。
回去.en: The movie is over; let's go back.

回去.zh: 他回去公司拿文件，很快就回来。
回去.en: He went back to the office to get the documents and will be back soon.

回去.zh: 如果你觉得不舒服，就先回去休息吧。
回去.en: If you don't feel well, go back and rest first.

正是.en: This is exactly what I was looking for.

正是.zh: 他说的那句话正是我想说的。
正是.en: What he said is exactly what I wanted to say.

正是.zh: 你来得正是时候，我们刚要吃饭。
正是.en: You came just in time; we were about to eat.

正是.zh: 这个颜色正是我喜欢的。
正是.en: This color is exactly the one I like.

正是.zh: 我们讨论的正是这个问题，你有好办法吗？
正是.en: We are discussing exactly this problem; do you have a good idea?

妻子.zh: 今天我和妻子一起去超市买东西。
妻子.en: Today my wife and I went to the supermarket to buy things.

妻子.zh: 他妻子在银行工作，每天很忙。
妻子.en: His wife works at a bank and is very busy every day.

妻子.zh: 虽然我妻子很累，但还是做了晚饭。
妻子.en: Although my wife was very tired, she still made dinner.
What food does your wife like to eat?

鱼.zh: 这条鱼是今天早上买的，很新鲜。
鱼.en: This fish was bought this morning, very fresh.

鱼.zh: 妈妈做鱼的时候喜欢放很多姜。
鱼.en: When mom cooks fish, she likes to put a lot of ginger.

鱼.zh: 昨天我们去河边钓鱼，钓到一条大鱼。
鱼.en: Yesterday we went fishing by the river and caught a big fish.

鱼.zh: 鱼在水里游来游去，看起来很开心。
鱼.en: The fish swims around in the water, looking very happy.

累.zh: 工作了一整天，我累得不想说话。
累.en: After working all day, I'm too tired to talk.

累.zh: 你累了吗？要不要休息一下？
累.en: Are you tired? Want to rest a bit?

累.zh: 虽然很累，但是看到孩子开心的样子就值得了。
累.en: Although very tired, seeing the child happy makes it worth it.

累.zh: 爬山太累了，我们下次不去了。
累.en: Mountain climbing is too tiring; we won't go next time.

打开.zh: 打开电脑后，先检查一下邮件。
打开.en: After turning on the computer, check your email first.

打开.zh: 他打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。
打开.en: He opened the window to let fresh air in.

打开.zh: 这本书我还没打开过呢。
打开.en: I haven't opened this book yet.

肉.zh: 这家超市的肉很新鲜，价格也合理。
肉.en: The meat at this supermarket is very fresh and the price is reasonable.

肉.zh: 烤肉的时候要注意火候，不然会糊。
肉.en: When grilling meat, pay attention to the heat, otherwise it will burn.

肉.zh: 妈妈今天做了红烧肉，特别好吃。
肉.en: Mom made braised pork today, especially delicious.
Eat more meat, it's good for your health.

全国.zh: 全国都在庆祝这个节日。
全国.en: The whole country is celebrating this festival.

全国.zh: 这个新闻在全国引起了很大的关注。
全国.en: This news has attracted great attention nationwide.

全国.zh: 全国各地的游客都来这个景点玩。
全国.en: Tourists from all over the country come to this scenic spot.

全国.zh: 虽然我们来自不同地方，但全国是一家人。
全国.en: Although we come from different places, the whole country is one family.

全国.zh: 这次考试是全国统一的，所以很难。
全国.en: This exam is nationwide unified, so it's very difficult.

班.en: I take the early shift bus to work.

班.zh: 今天我们班来了一个新同学。
班.en: Today a new classmate came to our class.

班.zh: 你明天上什么班？早班还是晚班？
班.en: What shift do you work tomorrow? Morning or evening?

班.zh: 这个航班因为天气原因取消了。
班.en: This flight was canceled due to weather.

班.zh: 我们班一共有三十个学生。
班.en: Our class has a total of 30 students.

坏.zh: 这个苹果坏了，不能吃了。
坏.en: This apple is bad, can't eat it.
The weather turned bad, it might rain.

坏.zh: 虽然电脑坏了，但他还是坚持工作。
坏.en: Although the computer is broken, he still insisted on working.

笔.zh: 这支笔写出来很流畅，我喜欢用。
笔.en: This pen writes very smoothly, I like using it.

笔.zh: 他买了一支很贵的钢笔送给朋友。
笔.en: He bought a very expensive fountain pen as a gift for a friend.

笔.zh: 考试的时候别忘了带笔和橡皮。
笔.en: Don't forget to bring a pen and eraser during the exam.

笔.zh: 我用笔在纸上画了一只猫。
笔.en: I used a pen to draw a cat on the paper.

上面.en: There is a glass of water on the table.

上面.zh: 图片上面画了一只小鸟。
上面.en: There is a bird drawn on the picture.

上面.zh: 你把杯子放在书架上面就行了。
上面.en: Just put the cup on top of the bookshelf.

上面.zh: 虽然上面写着他的名字，但那是我的书。
上面.en: Although it says his name on top, that is my book.

洗.en: Did you do the laundry today?
Remember to wash the dishes after eating.

洗.zh: 他每天洗两次澡，一次早上一次晚上。
洗.en: He takes a shower twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening.

洗.zh: 因为明天要拍照，所以我昨晚把头发洗了。
洗.en: Because I have a photo shoot tomorrow, I washed my hair last night.

后面.en: There's a park behind my house.

后面.zh: 商场后面可以免费停车。
后面.en: You can park for free behind the mall.

后面.zh: 队伍太长了，他只好站在后面等。
后面.en: The line was too long, so he had to stand in the back and wait.

后面.zh: 你先走，我跟在后面帮你拿东西。
后面.en: You go first, and I'll follow behind to help you carry things.

外面.en: Someone outside is looking for you.

外面.zh: 今天外面风很大，多穿点。
外面.en: It's very windy outside today; dress warmly.

外面.zh: 外面太吵了，我们进屋里说话吧。
外面.en: It's too noisy outside; let's go inside to talk.

外面.zh: 他喜欢在外面跑步，因为空气新鲜。
外面.en: He likes to run outside because the air is fresh.

瓶.en: Give me a bottle of water.
This bottle of soy sauce is almost empty.
He bought two bottles of beer.

瓶.zh: 我把那瓶醋放在冰箱里了。
瓶.en: I put that bottle of vinegar in the fridge.

瓶.zh: 她每天喝一瓶牛奶，所以身体很好。
瓶.en: She drinks a bottle of milk every day, so she's very healthy.

丈夫.zh: 丈夫和妻子一起去了超市。
丈夫.en: The husband and wife went to the supermarket together.

丈夫.zh: 她丈夫每天下班后都去接孩子。
丈夫.en: Her husband picks up the kids every day after work.

丈夫.zh: 虽然丈夫很忙，但他还是抽空陪家人。
丈夫.en: Although the husband is very busy, he still makes time for his family.

左.en: The seat on the left is empty.

左.zh: 你往左走就能看到银行。
左.en: Go left and you'll see the bank.

左.zh: 他用左手写字，是个左撇子。
左.en: He writes with his left hand; he's left-handed.

左.zh: 到了十字路口，你向左拐，然后直走。
左.en: At the intersection, turn left and then go straight.

下面.en: There's a cat under the table.
There are many fish under the bridge.

下面.zh: 床下面放了一个行李箱。
下面.en: There's a suitcase under the bed.

下面.zh: 你站到下面去，我在这上面拍照。
下面.en: Stand down there, and I'll take a photo from up here.

右.en: The book on the right is mine.

右.zh: 他在右手上戴了一块表。
右.en: He wears a watch on his right hand.

右.zh: 往前走，第二个路口右转就到了。
右.en: Go straight, turn right at the second intersection, and you'll arrive.

右.zh: 你把包放在右边的椅子上吧。
右.en: Put your bag on the chair on the right.

生日.en: What gift do you want for your birthday?

生日.zh: 我们给他办了一个生日派对。
生日.en: We threw him a birthday party.

生日.zh: 我每年生日都跟家人一起吃饭。
生日.en: Every year on my birthday, I have dinner with my family.

长大.en: I want to grow up quickly.
What do you want to do when you grow up?
She grew up in the countryside when she was little.

长大.zh: 孩子长大以后就不怎么粘父母了。
长大.en: After kids grow up, they don't cling to their parents as much.

长大.zh: 他在北京长大，所以说话带北京口音。
长大.en: He grew up in Beijing, so he speaks with a Beijing accent.

交给.zh: 我把钱交给他，然后他就走了。
交给.en: I gave him the money, and then he left.

交给.zh: 你把这个文件交给经理以后就下班吧。
交给.en: After you hand this document to the manager, you can leave work.

交给.zh: 老师让我们把作业交给组长。
交给.en: The teacher told us to hand in our homework to the group leader.

蛋.en: I ate an egg in the morning.

蛋.zh: 冰箱里还有几个鸡蛋，你煮一下吃吧。
蛋.en: There are a few eggs in the fridge, boil them and eat.

蛋.zh: 虽然我不爱吃蛋黄，但是蛋清很好吃。
蛋.en: Although I don't like egg yolk, the egg white is delicious.
This egg seems to be bad.
She bought two boxes of eggs at the supermarket.

有时.zh: 虽然天气很好，但有时也会下雨。
有时.en: Although the weather is nice, sometimes it rains.

有时.zh: 他有时工作到很晚，但第二天还是会早到。
有时.en: He sometimes works very late, but still arrives early the next day.

有时.zh: 有时我觉得一个人待着也挺好。
有时.en: Sometimes I think being alone is also fine.

有时.zh: 她有时打电话给我，有时发信息。
有时.en: She sometimes calls me, sometimes sends messages.

词.zh: 我学了一个新词，但不知道怎么用。
词.en: I learned a new word, but don't know how to use it.

词.zh: 如果你不认识这个词，可以查字典。
词.en: If you don't know this word, you can look it up in the dictionary.

词.zh: 他写文章时喜欢用复杂的词。
词.en: He likes to use complex words when writing essays.

词.zh: 这首歌的歌词写得很美。
词.en: The lyrics of this song are beautifully written.

鸟.en: There is a bird outside the window.

鸟.zh: 每天早上我都能听到鸟叫的声音。
鸟.en: Every morning I can hear the sound of birds chirping.

鸟.zh: 因为鸟飞走了，所以孩子哭了。
鸟.en: Because the bird flew away, the child cried.
He feeds birds in the park.

鸟.zh: 这种鸟冬天会飞到南方去。
鸟.en: This kind of bird flies south in winter.

想起.zh: 看到这张照片，我就想起了小时候的事。
想起.en: Seeing this photo, I recalled things from childhood.

想起.zh: 虽然很久没见，但他一开口我就想起了他的名字。
想起.en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, as soon as he spoke I remembered his name.

想起.zh: 你别提起他，我真不想想起那些事。
想起.en: Don't mention him, I really don't want to think about those things.

想起.zh: 每次听到这首歌，我都会想起那次旅行。
想起.en: Every time I hear this song, I think of that trip.

进去.zh: 我们排队等了好久才进去。
进去.en: We queued for a long time before getting in.

进去.zh: 如果门开着，你就直接进去。
进去.en: If the door is open, just go straight in.

进去.zh: 他推开门，慢慢地走进去。
进去.en: He pushed the door open and slowly walked in.

进去.zh: 别站在外面，快进去坐下。
进去.en: Don't stand outside, go in and sit down quickly.

疼.zh: 他摔了一跤，腿疼得走不了路。
疼.en: He fell down, his leg hurt so much he couldn't walk.

疼.zh: 虽然伤口很疼，但他没有哭。
疼.en: Although the wound was very painful, he didn't cry.

疼.zh: 你肚子疼吗？要不要去看医生？
疼.en: Does your stomach hurt? Do you want to see a doctor?

疼.zh: 打针的时候有一点疼，很快就好了。
疼.en: It hurts a little when getting an injection, but it's over quickly.

路上.zh: 我上班路上常常看到很多车。
路上.en: I often see many cars on my way to work.

路上.zh: 因为路上堵车，所以我迟到了。
路上.en: Because there was a traffic jam on the road, I was late.
Buy some fruit on your way back.
He found a cat on the road.

酒店.zh: 我们订了一个离机场很近的酒店。
酒店.en: We booked a hotel very close to the airport.

酒店.zh: 虽然酒店环境不错，但是服务很差。
酒店.en: Although the hotel environment is good, the service is terrible.

酒店.zh: 他住在酒店里，每天都有人打扫房间。
酒店.en: He stays in the hotel, and someone cleans the room every day.

酒店.zh: 这家酒店的自助早餐很好吃。
酒店.en: The buffet breakfast at this hotel is delicious.

咖啡.en: I want to drink a cup of coffee.

咖啡.zh: 每天早上我都喝一杯黑咖啡。
咖啡.en: Every morning I drink a cup of black coffee.

咖啡.zh: 这家店的咖啡很好喝，所以我经常来。
咖啡.en: The coffee at this shop is very good, so I often come here.

咖啡.zh: 你喜欢加糖还是加牛奶的咖啡？
咖啡.en: Do you like coffee with sugar or milk?

咖啡.zh: 咖啡喝多了晚上会睡不着。
咖啡.en: Drinking too much coffee will keep you awake at night.

接到.zh: 她接到一个好消息，开心得跳起来。
接到.en: She received some good news and jumped with joy.

接到.zh: 如果没接到通知，你就白跑一趟了。
接到.en: If you don't receive the notice, you'll have made a wasted trip.

接到.zh: 我刚刚接到妈妈的微信。
接到.en: I just received a WeChat message from my mom.

接到.zh: 他接到任务后立刻开始准备。
接到.en: He started preparing immediately after receiving the task.

考试.en: There is a math exam tomorrow.

考试.zh: 考试的时候千万别紧张。
考试.en: Don't be nervous during the exam.

考试.zh: 这次考试很难，我复习了很久。
考试.en: This exam was very hard; I studied for a long time.

考试.zh: 她考试考了满分，妈妈很高兴。
考试.en: She got full marks on the exam, and her mom was very happy.

考试.zh: 考试前要好好休息，不然会没精神。
考试.en: You should rest well before the exam, otherwise you'll have no energy.

慢.en: Slow down, be careful not to fall.

慢.zh: 这个网络好慢，我快疯了。
慢.en: This internet is so slow, I'm going crazy.

慢.zh: 虽然他学得慢，但是很认真。
慢.en: Although he learns slowly, he is very serious.

慢.zh: 你说话慢一点，我听不清楚。
慢.en: Speak slower, I can't hear clearly.

前面.zh: 你往前走，前面就是车站。
前面.en: Go straight ahead, the station is in front.
People in front, please make way.

前面.zh: 坐在前面能看得更清楚。
前面.en: Sitting in front allows you to see more clearly.

前面.zh: 如果你在前面路口左转，就能看到那家餐厅。
前面.en: If you turn left at the intersection ahead, you'll see that restaurant.

旁边.en: He is sitting right next to me.
There is a bookstore next to the school.
Put the cup next to me.

旁边.zh: 旁边的公园很适合散步。
旁边.en: The park nearby is great for a walk.

旁边.zh: 我旁边的那个人一直在打电话，很吵。
旁边.en: The person next to me was on the phone the whole time, very noisy.

大部分.en: Most of the students have come.

大部分.zh: 这个班大部分同学都通过了考试。
大部分.en: Most of the classmates in this class passed the exam.

大部分.zh: 我大部分时间都在家里看书。
大部分.en: I spend most of my time reading at home.

大部分.zh: 大部分水果我都喜欢吃，除了榴莲。
大部分.en: I like most fruits except durian.

大部分.zh: 虽然大部分工作完成了，但还有一些细节要处理。
大部分.en: Although most of the work is done, there are still some details to handle.

帮忙.zh: 我需要你帮忙搬一下桌子。
帮忙.en: I need your help to move the table.

帮忙.zh: 谢谢你来帮忙，不然我一个人忙不过来。
帮忙.en: Thank you for helping; otherwise I couldn't manage alone.

帮忙.zh: 帮忙的时候要小心，别摔坏了东西。
帮忙.en: Be careful when helping, don't break anything.

进来.en: Please come in and sit down.
It's too cold outside, come in quickly.
He didn't knock when he came in.
Change your shoes before you come in.

进来.zh: 如果下雨了，就赶紧进来避雨。
进来.en: If it rains, hurry inside to take shelter.

颜色.en: What color do you like best?

颜色.zh: 这件衣服的颜色不适合我。
颜色.en: The color of this clothing doesn't suit me.

颜色.zh: 秋天的树叶颜色真漂亮。
颜色.en: The colors of the autumn leaves are really beautiful.

颜色.zh: 不同的颜色会给人不同的感觉。
颜色.en: Different colors give people different feelings.

什么样.en: What kind of person is he?
What kind of phone do you want to buy?

什么样.zh: 我不知道他是什么样的人，但我觉得他不错。
什么样.en: I don't know what kind of person he is, but I think he's nice.

什么样.zh: 这件衣服是什么样的颜色？
什么样.en: What color is this piece of clothing?

什么样.zh: 你理想中的工作是什么样的？
什么样.en: What is your ideal job like?

那时.en: I was still young at that time.

那时.zh: 那时我们经常一起去公园。
那时.en: We often went to the park together back then.

那时.zh: 我们那时虽然很穷，但是很开心。
那时.en: Although we were poor at that time, we were very happy.

那时.zh: 那时他还没找到工作，心里很着急。
那时.en: At that time, he hadn't found a job yet and was very anxious.

那时.zh: 等我到了那时，再告诉你答案吧。
那时.en: When I get to that time, I'll tell you the answer.

心中.zh: 她心中一直记得那个地方。
心中.en: She always keeps that place in her heart.

心中.zh: 虽然他没有说出来，但我心中明白他的意思。
心中.en: Although he didn't say it, I understood his meaning in my heart.

心中.zh: 这件事在我心中留下了很深的印象。
心中.en: This matter left a deep impression on my heart.

心中.zh: 他心中充满了对未来的希望。
心中.en: His heart is full of hope for the future.

高中.en: I am in high school now.

高中.zh: 高中三年是我最努力的时候。
高中.en: The three years of high school were my hardest-working time.

高中.zh: 因为高中课业重，所以我很少出去玩。
高中.en: Because high school coursework is heavy, I rarely go out to play.

高中.zh: 他高中毕业后就去工作了。
高中.en: He went to work after graduating from high school.

高中.zh: 我们高中时的班主任很严格。
高中.en: Our high school homeroom teacher was very strict.

考.en: I have a math exam tomorrow.

考.zh: 他考了三次才通过驾照考试。
考.en: He passed the driving test only after taking it three times.

考.zh: 如果这次考不好，我就要复读了。
考.en: If I don't do well on this exam, I'll have to repeat the grade.
Which university are you planning to take the entrance exam for?

考.zh: 我这次考得还不错，比上次进步了。
考.en: I did pretty well on this exam, improving compared to last time.

英语.zh: 我每天花一小时学英语。
英语.en: I spend an hour every day learning English.

英语.zh: 虽然英语很难，但我还是坚持学。
英语.en: Although English is difficult, I still persist in learning it.

英语.zh: 他的英语口语比听力好。
英语.en: His spoken English is better than his listening.

英语.zh: 看英语电影对提高听力很有帮助。
英语.en: Watching English movies is very helpful for improving listening.

大多数.zh: 大多数学生都觉得这次考试太难了。
大多数.en: Most students think this exam is too difficult.

大多数.zh: 虽然有些人反对，但大多数还是支持这个计划。
大多数.en: Although some people oppose it, the majority still support this plan.

大多数.zh: 大多数情况下，这种药是安全的。
大多数.en: In most cases, this medicine is safe.

大多数.zh: 这个城市大多数居民都在市中心工作。
大多数.en: Most residents of this city work in the city center.

上去.zh: 如果你觉得冷，就上去穿件衣服。
上去.en: If you feel cold, go upstairs and put on some clothes.

上去.zh: 把箱子搬上去有点费劲。
上去.en: It's a bit of a struggle to carry the box up.

上去.zh: 他看上去很年轻，其实已经四十了。
上去.en: He looks very young, but actually he is forty.

红色.zh: 春节的时候大家都穿红色衣服。
红色.en: During the Spring Festival, everyone wears red clothes.

红色.zh: 因为红色很吉祥，所以很多中国人喜欢。
红色.en: Because red is very auspicious, many Chinese people like it.

红色.zh: 那辆红色的车是我姐姐的。
红色.en: That red car is my sister's.

红色.zh: 她用红色笔改正作业里的错误。
红色.en: She uses a red pen to correct mistakes in the homework.

游.zh: 他每天下午去游泳池游一会儿。
游.en: He goes to the pool every afternoon for a swim.

游.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但他还是坚持游了一个小时。
游.en: Although it was very cold, he still insisted on swimming for an hour.
She swims even faster than I do.

游.zh: 夏天到了，很多人喜欢去海边游。
游.en: Summer has come, and many people like to go swimming at the beach.

放下.zh: 他放下书包就去洗澡了。
放下.en: He put down his backpack and went to take a shower.
You should let go of the past.

放下.zh: 你先放下工作，休息一会儿。
放下.en: You put down work first and rest a while.
Put down your chopsticks, let's chat.

一会儿.en: I'll be there in a moment.

一会儿.zh: 你等一会儿，我马上回来。
一会儿.en: Wait a moment, I'll be right back.

一会儿.zh: 你先坐下，一会儿再跟我说。
一会儿.en: Sit down first, then talk to me in a little while.
Let's go to the supermarket in a bit.

一会儿.zh: 他一会儿哭一会儿笑，很奇怪。
一会儿.en: He cries one moment and laughs the next, very strange.

早就.en: She already finished cooking long ago.

早就.zh: 虽然你才说，但我早就听说了。
早就.en: Although you just said it, I heard about it long ago.

早就.zh: 这部电影我早就看过了。
早就.en: I already saw this movie long ago.
He has wanted to buy that car for a long time.

机场.en: I'm going to the airport to pick someone up.

机场.zh: 明天早上我们要去机场送朋友。
机场.en: Tomorrow morning we are going to the airport to see off a friend.

机场.zh: 从这儿到机场开车要一个小时。
机场.en: It takes an hour to drive from here to the airport.
There are many shops in the airport.

机场.zh: 虽然机场很远，但我们可以坐地铁。
机场.en: Although the airport is far, we can take the subway.

多久.en: How much longer until we arrive?

多久.zh: 我不知道他会在这里住多久。
多久.en: I don't know how long he will stay here.
How long have you been learning Chinese?

踢.zh: 我踢了一下球，结果打碎了玻璃。
踢.en: I kicked the ball and ended up breaking the glass.
The child is kicking around on the ground.

踢.zh: 他生气地踢了椅子一脚。

舒服.zh: 天气太热了，一点都不舒服。
舒服.en: The weather is too hot, not comfortable at all.

舒服.zh: 如果觉得不舒服，就休息一下。
舒服.en: If you feel uncomfortable, take a rest.
After showering, the body feels great.

舒服.zh: 这件衣服穿起来很舒服。
舒服.en: This clothes is comfortable to wear.

上周.en: I went to Beijing last week.

上周.zh: 上周我们公司开了一个重要的会。
上周.en: Last week our company had an important meeting.

上周.zh: 因为上周下雨，所以活动取消了。
上周.en: Because it rained last week, the event was canceled.

上周.zh: 你上周买的书看完了吗？
上周.en: Did you finish reading the book you bought last week?

黑色.zh: 她穿了一件黑色的裙子。
虽然黑色很显瘦，但我更喜欢白色。
黑色.en: Although black is slimming, I prefer white.

黑色.zh: 黑色星期五有很多折扣。

绿色.zh: 如果你喜欢绿色，就买这件衣服吧。
绿色.en: If you like green, then buy this clothes.
Green food is good for health.

绿色.zh: 交通灯变绿色了，可以走了。
绿色.en: The traffic light turned green, we can go.

院.en: A big tree is planted in the yard.

院.zh: 她住院了，所以今天没来上班。
院.en: She was hospitalized, so she didn't come to work today.

院.zh: 这个医院的院子很大，可以散步。
院.en: The courtyard of this hospital is very large, so you can take a walk.

院.zh: 我爷爷住在养老院，我每周都去看他。
院.en: My grandpa lives in a nursing home, and I visit him every week.

院.zh: 电影院里人很多，我们没买到票。
院.en: There were many people in the cinema, so we couldn't get tickets.

网上.zh: 网上说的不一定都是真的。
网上.en: What's said online isn't necessarily all true.

网上.zh: 因为网上可以查资料，所以我很少去图书馆。
网上.en: Because you can look up information online, I rarely go to the library.

网上.zh: 他喜欢在网上跟朋友聊天。
网上.en: He likes chatting with friends online.

网上.zh: 网上购物很方便，但是要注意安全。
网上.en: Online shopping is very convenient, but you need to pay attention to safety.

旅游.en: I want to travel during the summer vacation.

旅游.zh: 旅游的时候要注意安全。
旅游.en: You should pay attention to safety when traveling.

旅游.zh: 如果明天天气好，我们就去旅游。
旅游.en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we will go traveling.

旅游.zh: 他每次旅游都会买很多纪念品。
旅游.en: He buys a lot of souvenirs every time he travels.

旅游.zh: 这次旅游我们去了三个城市，玩得很开心。
旅游.en: On this trip we visited three cities and had a great time.

足球.zh: 昨晚的足球比赛很精彩。
足球.en: Last night's football match was very exciting.

足球.zh: 虽然我不会踢足球，但我爱看比赛。
足球.en: Although I can't play football, I love watching matches.

足球.zh: 学校有一个很大的足球场。
足球.en: The school has a very large football field.

足球.zh: 他们因为足球成了好朋友。
足球.en: They became good friends because of football.

绿.en: The light ahead is green, you can go.

绿.zh: 这件绿衣服很好看，我买了一件。
绿.en: This green dress is very nice, so I bought one.
Spring has arrived, and the mountains have turned green.

绿.zh: 她喜欢绿色，所以房间刷成了浅绿。
绿.en: She likes green, so she painted her room light green.

白色.zh: 我最喜欢的颜色是白色。
因为白色容易脏，所以我不常穿。
白色.en: Because white gets dirty easily, I don't wear it often.

白色.zh: 婚礼上新娘穿着白色婚纱。
白色.en: The bride wore a white wedding dress at the wedding.

好事.zh: 他喜欢做好事帮助别人。
好事.en: He likes to do good deeds and help others.

好事.zh: 虽然遇到挫折，但这也是件好事。
好事.en: Although we encountered setbacks, this is also a good thing.

好事.zh: 好事多磨，最后我们还是成功了。
好事.en: Good things are a long time coming, but we finally succeeded.

好事.zh: 她找到了一份好工作，真是个好事。
好事.en: She found a good job, which is really a good thing.

题.zh: 考试题一共有十道，我都会做。
题.en: There are ten exam questions in total, and I can do all of them.

题.zh: 如果你有不会的题，可以问老师。
题.en: If you have questions you don't understand, you can ask the teacher.

题.zh: 这道题他想了很久才做出来。
题.en: He thought about this problem for a long time before solving it.

送给.en: I give this book to you.
He gave his girlfriend a bouquet of flowers.

送给.zh: 这是我亲手做的蛋糕，送给你吃。
送给.en: This is a cake I made myself; I'm giving it to you to eat.

送给.zh: 因为生日到了，朋友送给我一个礼物。
送给.en: Because my birthday came, a friend gave me a gift.

送给.zh: 她把那件漂亮的裙子送给了妹妹。
送给.en: She gave that beautiful dress to her younger sister.

门口.en: He is waiting for me at the door.
There are many small stalls at the school gate.

门口.zh: 你把垃圾放在门口就行。
门口.en: You can just leave the trash at the door.

门口.zh: 因为门口堵车，我们迟到了。
门口.en: Because there was a traffic jam at the entrance, we were late.

门口.zh: 他站在电影院门口，手里拿着两张票。
门口.en: He stood at the cinema entrance, holding two tickets in his hand.

比如说.en: For example, I like to eat apples.

比如说.zh: 你可以带一些零食，比如说薯片或者饼干。
比如说.en: You can bring some snacks, for example chips or cookies.

比如说.zh: 很多地方我都想去，比如说日本和韩国。
比如说.en: There are many places I want to go, for example Japan and South Korea.

比如说.zh: 学习语言有很多方法，比如说多听多说。
比如说.en: There are many ways to learn a language, for example listening and speaking more.

比如说.zh: 周末可以做很多事，比如说看电影或者逛街。
比如说.en: You can do many things on weekends, for example watch movies or go shopping.

不好意思.zh: 不好意思，我不小心把杯子打碎了。
不好意思.en: Sorry, I accidentally broke the cup.

不好意思.zh: 不好意思，请问地铁站在哪里？
不好意思.en: Excuse me, where is the subway station?

不好意思.zh: 刚才我说错话了，真是不好意思。
不好意思.en: I said something wrong just now, I'm really sorry.

不好意思.zh: 不好意思打扰一下，你能帮我个忙吗？
不好意思.en: Sorry to bother you, can you help me?

奶奶.zh: 这个周末我要去看奶奶，给她带点水果。
奶奶.en: This weekend I'm going to see grandma and bring her some fruit.

奶奶.zh: 奶奶年纪大了，走路不太方便。
奶奶.en: Grandma is old and has trouble walking.

奶奶.zh: 小时候我经常跟奶奶一起散步。
奶奶.en: When I was little, I often took walks with grandma.

奶奶.zh: 奶奶特别喜欢种花，院子里全是花。
奶奶.en: Grandma really likes planting flowers; the yard is full of them.

碰到.zh: 昨天我在超市碰到以前的同学了。
碰到.en: Yesterday I ran into a former classmate at the supermarket.

碰到.zh: 走路的时候要小心，别碰到别人。
碰到.en: Be careful when walking, don't bump into others.

碰到.zh: 我在路上碰到一只流浪猫，就喂了它一点吃的。
碰到.en: I encountered a stray cat on the road, so I fed it some food.

碰到.zh: 工作上碰到问题可以随时问我。
碰到.en: If you encounter any problems at work, feel free to ask me.

蓝色.en: This piece of clothing is blue.

蓝色.zh: 天空是蓝色的，云是白色的，真好看。
蓝色.en: The sky is blue, the clouds are white, it's really beautiful.

蓝色.zh: 我的书包是蓝色的，很容易认出来。
蓝色.en: My backpack is blue, it's easy to recognize.

蓝色.zh: 她喜欢蓝色，所以房间刷成了蓝色。
蓝色.en: She likes blue, so she painted the room blue.

蓝色.zh: 蓝色的大海让我觉得很放松。
蓝色.en: The blue sea makes me feel very relaxed.

右边.en: There's a supermarket on the right.

右边.zh: 你到了路口以后，往右边拐就能看见地铁站。
右边.en: After you reach the intersection, turn right and you'll see the subway station.

右边.zh: 我的座位在右边第二排。
右边.en: My seat is on the right, second row.

右边.zh: 图片里的那个人站在右边。
右边.en: The person in the picture is standing on the right.

右边.zh: 请把杯子放在桌子的右边。
右边.en: Please put the cup on the right side of the table.

接下来.zh: 我们先吃饭，接下来去看电影。
接下来.en: Let's eat first, then go watch a movie.

接下来.zh: 接下来我给大家介绍一下今天的安排。
接下来.en: Next, I'll introduce today's schedule to everyone.

接下来.zh: 考试结束了，接下来就是等成绩了。
接下来.en: The exam is over, next is waiting for the results.

接下来.zh: 这件事处理完，接下来还有别的事要做。
接下来.en: After handling this matter, there are still other things to do.

有意思.zh: 我觉得这部电影很有意思，推荐你也看看。
有意思.en: I think this movie is very interesting, I recommend you watch it too.

有意思.zh: 他的想法很有意思，我们可以讨论一下。
有意思.en: His idea is very interesting, we can discuss it.

有意思.zh: 这个游戏越玩越有意思，你试试看。
有意思.en: This game gets more interesting the more you play, give it a try.

有意思.zh: 听他说以前的故事，挺有意思的。
有意思.en: Listening to him tell stories from the past is quite interesting.

出门.zh: 出门的时候记得带钥匙，别忘啦。
出门.en: Remember to bring your keys when you go out, don't forget.

出门.zh: 今天下雨了，出门别忘了带伞。
出门.en: It's raining today, don't forget to bring an umbrella when you go out.

出门.zh: 他每天出门前都会检查一下钱包。
出门.en: He checks his wallet every day before going out.

出门.zh: 周末天气好，我们出门走走吧。
出门.en: The weather is nice on the weekend, let's go out for a walk.

地铁.en: I take the subway to work.

地铁.zh: 从我家到公司，坐地铁只需要二十分钟。
地铁.en: From my home to the office, it only takes 20 minutes by subway.

地铁.zh: 地铁站里人很多，要小心钱包。
地铁.en: The subway station is very crowded, be careful with your wallet.

地铁.zh: 坐地铁比开车快，而且不用担心停车。
地铁.en: Taking the subway is faster than driving, and you don't have to worry about parking.

地铁.zh: 第一次坐地铁的时候，我差点迷路了。
地铁.en: The first time I took the subway, I almost got lost.

小时候.en: I was very naughty as a child.

小时候.zh: 小时候我经常去外婆家玩。
小时候.en: When I was little, I often went to my grandma's house to play.

小时候.zh: 虽然小时候家里穷，但是很快乐。
小时候.en: Although my family was poor when I was little, I was very happy.

小时候.zh: 你小时候的梦想是什么？
小时候.en: What was your dream when you were a child?

小时候.zh: 小时候我们住在乡下，空气特别好。
小时候.en: When we were kids, we lived in the countryside, and the air was really good.

爷爷.en: Grandpa is eighty years old this year.
My grandpa likes to grow flowers.

爷爷.zh: 爷爷经常给我讲他年轻时的故事。
爷爷.en: Grandpa often tells me stories about when he was young.

爷爷.zh: 因为爷爷身体不好，所以很少出门。
爷爷.en: Because grandpa is not in good health, he rarely goes out.
Grandpa, would you like tea or coffee?

咱.en: We need to finish our homework quickly.

咱.zh: 既然咱都同意了，那就这样吧。
咱.en: Since we all agree, let's do it this way.

咱.zh: 咱家的小狗丢了，快去找找。
咱.en: Our family's little dog is lost, hurry and look for it.

上来.en: He just came up the stairs.

上来.zh: 你从下面走上来累不累？
上来.en: Are you tired from walking up from below?

上来.zh: 他一上来就问我问题，我都没准备好。
上来.en: He started asking me questions right away, and I wasn't ready.

好人.en: There are still more good people in the world.

好人.zh: 你帮我这么多，真是个好人。
好人.en: You helped me so much, you're really a good person.

好人.zh: 虽然他不爱说话，但大家都说他是个好人。
好人.en: Although he doesn't talk much, everyone says he's a good person.

好人.zh: 好人有时也会遇到麻烦。
好人.en: Good people sometimes get into trouble too.

大声.en: Don't be noisy in the library.

大声.zh: 因为音乐太吵，我不得不大声说话。
大声.en: Because the music was too loud, I had to speak loudly.
What did you say loudly just now?

市长.en: The mayor is coming for an inspection today.

市长.zh: 市长在会议上发表了讲话。
市长.en: The mayor gave a speech at the meeting.

市长.zh: 虽然市长很忙，但他还是抽空见了我们。
市长.en: Although the mayor was very busy, he still took time to see us.

市长.zh: 新市长上任后，城市变化很大。
市长.en: Since the new mayor took office, the city has changed a lot.

这时.en: At this moment, it suddenly started raining.

这时.zh: 他正要出门，这时电话响了。
这时.en: He was about to go out when the phone rang.
At that moment, the teacher walked into the classroom.

这时.zh: 我们正在吃饭，这时有人敲门。
这时.en: We were eating when someone knocked on the door.

这时.zh: 这时我才明白你的意思。
这时.en: Only then did I understand what you meant.

科学家.en: He wants to become a scientist when he grows up.

科学家.zh: 科学家们正在研究这个新问题。
科学家.en: Scientists are researching this new problem.

科学家.zh: 虽然科学家很聪明，但他们也经常失败。
科学家.en: Although scientists are very smart, they often fail too.

科学家.zh: 这位科学家发明了一种新药。
科学家.en: This scientist invented a new medicine.

姓.en: His surname is Zhang and given name Wei.

姓.zh: 因为姓李的人很多，所以容易重名。
姓.en: Because many people have the surname Li, it's easy to have the same name.
May I ask your honorable surname?

篮球.zh: 虽然下雨了，但他还是坚持去打篮球。
篮球.en: Although it rained, he still insisted on playing basketball.

篮球.zh: 这个篮球是我生日的时候朋友送的。
篮球.en: This basketball was a gift from a friend on my birthday.

篮球.zh: 你喜欢看NBA还是喜欢自己打篮球？
篮球.en: Do you like watching the NBA or playing basketball yourself?

大门.zh: 公司大门旁边有个保安亭。
大门.en: There's a security booth next to the company's main gate.

大门.zh: 他们在大门口等了你半天。
大门.en: They waited for you at the main entrance for a long time.

大门.zh: 因为台风来了，所以大门被锁上了。
大门.en: Because the typhoon came, the gate was locked.

大门.zh: 新小区的大门装上了智能门禁系统。
大门.en: The new community's main gate has been equipped with a smart access control system.

不一定.en: Expensive things are not necessarily easy to use.

不一定.zh: 你这么做，结果不一定会好。
不一定.en: If you do this, the result may not necessarily be good.

不一定.zh: 虽然大家都说这家店好，但不一定适合你。
不一定.en: Although everyone says this shop is good, it may not necessarily suit you.

不一定.zh: 周末去爬山，但不一定非要去那座山。
不一定.en: We're going hiking on the weekend, but it doesn't have to be that mountain.

游泳.zh: 夏天我们常去河里游泳。
游泳.en: In summer we often go swimming in the river.

游泳.zh: 他游泳游了两个小时还没累。
游泳.en: He has been swimming for two hours and isn't tired yet.

游泳.zh: 因为天气太热，所以大家都想去游泳。
游泳.en: Because the weather is too hot, everyone wants to go swimming.

游泳.zh: 游泳之前一定要做好热身运动。
游泳.en: You must do warm-up exercises before swimming.

裤子.zh: 他穿了一条黑色的裤子。
裤子.en: He is wearing a pair of black pants.

裤子.zh: 你昨天买的那条裤子很好看。
裤子.en: The pants you bought yesterday look very nice.

裤子.zh: 虽然裤子有点贵，但是质量很好。
裤子.en: Although the pants are a bit expensive, the quality is very good.

跳舞.zh: 我们晚上一起去跳舞吧。
她在学校学了三年跳舞。
跳舞.en: She studied dancing at school for three years.

跳舞.zh: 虽然他很害羞，但跳舞的时候特别自信。
跳舞.en: Although he is very shy, he is especially confident when dancing.

跳舞.zh: 这个广场上每天都有很多人跳舞。
跳舞.en: Every day there are many people dancing on this square.

青少年.zh: 青少年要注意保护视力。
青少年.en: Teenagers should take care of their eyesight.

青少年.zh: 这个活动特别适合青少年参加。
青少年.en: This activity is especially suitable for teenagers to join.

青少年.zh: 青少年时期是性格形成的重要阶段。
青少年.en: Adolescence is an important stage for character formation.

青少年.zh: 因为青少年好奇心强，所以容易沉迷游戏。
青少年.en: Because teenagers are curious, they easily get addicted to games.

青少年.zh: 学校和家庭都应该多关注青少年的心理健康。
青少年.en: Both schools and families should pay more attention to teenagers' mental health.

阴.en: The weather is very overcast today.
On cloudy days I always feel like sleeping.

阴.zh: 虽然现在是阴天，但下午可能会出太阳。
阴.en: Although it's cloudy now, the sun might come out in the afternoon.

阴.zh: 你带伞了吗？外面阴得很厉害。
阴.en: Did you bring an umbrella? It's very cloudy outside.

阴.zh: 这个房间有点阴，最好开一下灯。
阴.en: This room is a bit dim, better turn on the light.

上网.en: He goes online every day to look up information.

上网.zh: 因为家里没有网络，所以我只能去网吧上网。
上网.en: Because there's no internet at home, I can only go to an internet café to go online.

上网.zh: 上网时间太久对眼睛不好。
上网.en: Spending too much time online is bad for your eyes.

上网.zh: 你现在上网是为了工作还是玩游戏？
上网.en: Are you online now for work or to play games?

商场.en: Let's go hang out at the mall.

商场.zh: 这家商场周末人非常多。
商场.en: This mall is very crowded on weekends.

商场.zh: 虽然商场很大，但我很快就找到了那家店。
商场.en: Although the mall is very big, I quickly found that store.

商场.zh: 商场一楼有卖奶茶的地方。
商场.en: There's a place selling milk tea on the first floor of the mall.

商场.zh: 你平时喜欢去网上购物还是逛商场？
商场.en: Do you usually prefer shopping online or going to the mall?

外国.zh: 我从来没去过外国，所以很想去看看。
外国.en: I've never been abroad, so I really want to go and see.

外国.zh: 这家餐厅的外国菜很好吃。
外国.en: The foreign dishes at this restaurant are delicious.

外国.zh: 外国的东西不一定都比中国的好。
外国.en: Foreign things are not necessarily better than Chinese ones.

姓名.en: Please write down your full name.

姓名.zh: 我需要核对一下你的姓名。
姓名.en: I need to verify your full name.

姓名.zh: 报名的时候要填姓名和地址。
姓名.en: You need to fill in your name and address when registering.

姓名.zh: 他的姓名在名单上找不到。
姓名.en: His name can't be found on the list.

姓名.zh: 因为姓名写错了，所以快递没收到。
姓名.en: Because the name was written wrong, the package wasn't received.

一部分.zh: 我只完成了一部分工作。
一部分.en: I only finished part of the work.

一部分.zh: 这些钱是我的学费的一部分。
一部分.en: This money is part of my tuition fees.

一部分.zh: 这本书我只看了前面一部分。
一部分.en: I only read the first part of this book.

一部分.zh: 大部分同学都来了，还有一部分没到。
一部分.en: Most classmates are here, but some haven't arrived yet.

一部分.zh: 这个问题的一部分答案我也不知道。
一部分.en: I don't know part of the answer to this question either.

车站.en: The station is here, get off quickly.
I'll wait for you at the station.

车站.zh: 去火车站坐地铁很方便。
车站.en: Taking the subway to the train station is very convenient.
Which station do you board from?

车站.zh: 因为下大雨，所以车站里有很多人。
车站.en: Because it was raining heavily, there were many people at the station.

走路.en: I walk to work every day.
Walking is very good for your health.

走路.zh: 这里不远，走路十分钟就到了。
走路.en: It's not far from here, just a ten-minute walk.
He walks very fast, I can't keep up.

走路.zh: 如果不想坐车，我们可以走路过去。
走路.en: If you don't want to take the car, we can walk there.

左边.zh: 我的左边坐着一个外国人。
左边.en: There is a foreigner sitting on my left.

左边.zh: 左边那个房子就是我家。
左边.en: The house on the left is my home.

左边.zh: 你看到左边的商店了吗？
左边.en: Do you see the shop on the left?

左边.zh: 把书放在桌子的左边，右边放水杯。
左边.en: Put the book on the left side of the table and the cup on the right.

拿到.zh: 考试结果明天才能拿到。
拿到.en: The exam results won't be available until tomorrow.

拿到.zh: 他拿到了第一名，很高兴。
拿到.en: He got first place and was very happy.

拿到.zh: 因为我提前报名，所以拿到了优惠券。
拿到.en: Because I registered early, I got the coupon.

全家.zh: 我们全家都喜欢吃饺子。
全家.en: My whole family likes eating dumplings.
During Spring Festival, the whole family eats together.

全家.zh: 这张照片是我们全家的合影。
全家.en: This photo is a picture of my whole family.
His whole family moved to Shanghai.

全家.zh: 虽然很忙，但周末全家还是会聚会。
全家.en: Although busy, the whole family still gets together on weekends.

从小.en: I've liked drawing since I was a child.
He has grown up in Beijing since childhood.

从小.zh: 她从小学习钢琴，现在弹得很好。
从小.en: She has been learning piano since childhood, and now she plays very well.
I haven't liked eating greens since I was little.

从小.zh: 因为从小受父母影响，所以我也当了老师。
从小.en: Because I was influenced by my parents since childhood, I also became a teacher.

爱好.zh: 他有很多爱好，比如游泳和唱歌。
爱好.en: He has many hobbies, such as swimming and singing.

爱好.zh: 这个周末我想发展一个新爱好。
爱好.en: This weekend I want to develop a new hobby.

爱好.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但我还是坚持自己的爱好。
爱好.en: Although I'm very busy with work, I still keep up with my hobbies.

多云.zh: 天气预报说下午多云，可能会下雨。
多云.en: The weather forecast says it'll be cloudy in the afternoon, and it might rain.

多云.zh: 虽然多云，但是我还是去散步了。
多云.en: Although it was cloudy, I still went for a walk.

多云.zh: 多云的时候，紫外线还是很强。
多云.en: When it's cloudy, the UV rays are still strong.

多云.zh: 明天多云转晴，适合出去玩。
多云.en: Tomorrow it will be cloudy then clear up, good for going out.

教室.en: There is no one in the classroom.
We have class in the classroom.

教室.zh: 他走进教室，发现灯没关。
教室.en: He walked into the classroom and found the lights were off.

教室.zh: 因为教室里太吵，所以我去了图书馆。
教室.en: Because the classroom was too noisy, I went to the library.

教室.zh: 放学后，教室很快就没有人了。
教室.en: After school, the classroom quickly became empty.

快要.zh: 电影快要开始了，我们快走吧。
快要.en: The movie is about to start, let's go quickly.

快要.zh: 天快要黑了，我们回家吧。
快要.en: It's getting dark soon, let's go home.

快要.zh: 如果你快要考试了，就要好好复习。
快要.en: If you are about to take an exam, you should review well.

快要.zh: 他快要毕业了，正在找工作呢。
快要.en: He is about to graduate and is looking for a job.

门票.en: How much is the entrance ticket?

门票.zh: 今天的门票已经卖完了。
门票.en: Today's tickets are already sold out.

门票.zh: 因为没带门票，所以他进不去。
门票.en: Because he didn't bring the ticket, he couldn't get in.

门票.zh: 这个景点的门票很便宜，只要二十块。
门票.en: This scenic spot's ticket is very cheap, only twenty bucks.

机票.en: Is the plane ticket very expensive?
I booked a plane ticket for tomorrow.
What time is your plane ticket?

机票.zh: 因为机票打折，所以我买了。
机票.en: Because the plane ticket was on sale, I bought it.

机票.zh: 去北京的机票比去上海的贵。
机票.en: The plane ticket to Beijing is more expensive than the one to Shanghai.

走过.zh: 他走过我身边，一句话也没说。
走过.en: He walked past me without saying a word.

走过.zh: 我们走过公园，看到了很多花。
走过.en: We walked through the park and saw many flowers.
Walk past this street and you'll find the supermarket.

走过.zh: 她走过桥的时候，不小心摔了一跤。
走过.en: When she was walking across the bridge, she accidentally fell.

得出.zh: 经过计算，我得出了结果。
得出.en: After calculation, I got the result.

得出.zh: 从这件事我们可以得出什么教训？
得出.en: What lesson can we draw from this matter?

得出.zh: 虽然数据很多，但是很难得出准确结论。
得出.en: Although there is a lot of data, it's hard to reach an accurate conclusion.

大海.en: He sat by the sea, looking at the ocean.

大海.zh: 虽然大海很美，但是游泳要小心。
大海.en: Although the sea is beautiful, you need to be careful when swimming.

大海.zh: 我第一次见到大海的时候，特别兴奋。
大海.en: When I first saw the sea, I was very excited.

这时候.zh: 我正在吃饭，这时候电话响了。
这时候.en: I was eating, and at that moment the phone rang.

这时候.zh: 如果你这时候出门，可能会堵车。
这时候.en: If you go out at this time, you might get stuck in traffic.

这时候.zh: 等到我们都准备好了，这时候再出发。
这时候.en: Wait until we are all ready, and then set off at that moment.

坏人.en: The bad guy was taken away.

坏人.zh: 电影里的坏人特别可恶。
坏人.en: The villain in the movie is especially nasty.

坏人.zh: 虽然他是坏人，但是也有善良的一面。
坏人.en: Although he is a bad person, he also has a kind side.

坏人.zh: 不要跟坏人交朋友，会学坏的。
坏人.en: Don't make friends with bad people, or you'll pick up bad habits.

手表.zh: 他送了一块新手表给我当生日礼物。
手表.en: He gave me a new watch as a birthday gift.

手表.zh: 我每天早上都会戴手表。
手表.en: I wear my watch every morning.

手表.zh: 因为手表没电了，所以时间不准。
手表.en: Because the watch battery died, the time is wrong.

手表.zh: 这块手表是爸爸的，很旧了。
手表.en: This watch is Dad's, it's very old.

夜里.en: I often can't sleep at night.

夜里.zh: 虽然夜里很冷，但他还是出去了。
夜里.en: Although it was cold at night, he still went out.
Last night there was a heavy rain.

夜里.zh: 夜里走路要小心，注意安全。
夜里.en: Be careful walking at night, pay attention to safety.

音乐会.zh: 我买了两张音乐会的票。
因为音乐会太吵，所以我不喜欢。
音乐会.en: Because the concert is too loud, I don't like it.

音乐会.zh: 这个周末有一个流行音乐会。
音乐会.en: There is a pop concert this weekend.

音乐会.zh: 她邀请我去听古典音乐会。
音乐会.en: She invited me to listen to a classical concert.

找出.en: Find out where the problem is.
Can you help me find the keys?

找出.zh: 只要仔细看，就能找出不同。
找出.en: As long as you look carefully, you can find the differences.
The teacher asked us to find the mistakes.

找出.zh: 他花了很长时间才找出答案。
找出.en: He spent a long time finding the answer.

举手.en: When you have a question, please raise your hand.
If you agree, raise your hand.
He raised his hand to indicate he wanted to speak.

举手.zh: 老师提问后，大家都举手了。
举手.en: After the teacher asked a question, everyone raised their hands.

出国.en: He is going abroad for travel next month.

出国.zh: 因为工作原因，他经常出国。
出国.en: Due to work reasons, he often goes abroad.
Before going abroad, you need to get your passport ready.

下雪.en: It often snows in the north in winter.

下雪.zh: 虽然下雪很冷，但是很好看。
下雪.en: Although snow is very cold, it's very beautiful.

下雪.zh: 下雪的时候可以堆雪人。
下雪.en: When it snows, you can build snowmen.

下雪.zh: 如果明天不下雪，我们就去爬山。
下雪.en: If it doesn't snow tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

英文.zh: 我的英文不太好，需要学习。
英文.en: My English is not good, I need to study.

英文.zh: 因为工作需要，我在学英文。
英文.en: Because of work, I am learning English.

英文.zh: 这篇文章是用英文写的。
英文.en: This article is written in English.

跑步.zh: 每天早上他都去公园跑步。
跑步.en: He goes running in the park every morning.

跑步.zh: 虽然很累，但他坚持跑步。
跑步.en: Although very tired, he insists on running.

跑步.zh: 她每天跑步半小时来锻炼身体。
跑步.en: She runs for half an hour every day to exercise.

骑车.en: I ride a bike to school.
He rides a bike to go to work at the company.

骑车.zh: 因为骑车方便，所以我经常骑车。
骑车.en: Because riding a bike is convenient, I often ride.
When riding a bike, you should wear a helmet.

骑车.zh: 周末我们一家人一起骑车出去玩。
骑车.en: On weekends our family rides bikes together to go out and play.

海边.en: Let's go play at the beach.
I like to walk along the beach.

海边.zh: 昨天我们在海边看日落了。
海边.en: Yesterday we watched the sunset at the beach.

海边.zh: 要是明天天气好，我们就去海边烧烤。
海边.en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go have a barbecue at the beach.

海边.zh: 他住在海边，每天都能听到海浪声。
海边.en: He lives by the sea and can hear the waves every day.

老朋友.zh: 今天见到老朋友真开心。
老朋友.en: I'm so happy to see an old friend today.

老朋友.zh: 我和老朋友一起吃了顿饭。
老朋友.en: I had a meal with an old friend.

老朋友.zh: 虽然好久没见，但老朋友还是那么亲切。
老朋友.en: Although we haven't seen each other for a long time, old friends are still so warm.

老朋友.zh: 她是我从小学就认识的老朋友了。
老朋友.en: She is an old friend I've known since elementary school.

走开.zh: 那只猫看到我就走开了。
走开.en: That cat walked away when it saw me.

走开.zh: 如果你不想帮忙，就请走开。
走开.en: If you don't want to help, please go away.

走开.zh: 他生气地对我说：“走开，别管我！”
走开.en: He said to me angrily, 'Go away, leave me alone!'

小声.zh: 请小声说话，孩子在睡觉。
小声.en: Please speak softly, the child is sleeping.

小声.zh: 她小声地告诉我这个秘密。
小声.en: She told me the secret in a low voice.

小声.zh: 如果你要问问题，请小声说。
小声.en: If you want to ask a question, please speak softly.

送到.en: I walked him to the door.
When will the package be delivered?

送到.zh: 请把这份文件送到办公室。
送到.en: Please deliver this document to the office.

送到.zh: 他每天都会把早餐送到我房间。
送到.en: He brings breakfast to my room every day.

送到.zh: 虽然路很远，我还是把她送到了家。
送到.en: Although it was far, I still saw her home.

药店.en: I'm going to the pharmacy to buy some medicine.

药店.zh: 你感冒了，去药店买药吧。
药店.en: You have a cold, go buy some medicine at the pharmacy.

药店.zh: 因为发烧，他昨晚去了药店。
药店.en: Because he had a fever, he went to the pharmacy last night.

回国.en: I'm going back to my country next month.
He has been back in his home country for three years.
When do you plan to return to your home country?

回国.zh: 他在国外工作十年后终于回国了。
回国.en: After working abroad for ten years, he finally returned to his home country.

回国.zh: 虽然很想回国，但工作太忙了。
回国.en: Although I really want to go back to my home country, work is too busy.

晴.en: Tomorrow will be sunny, let's go hiking.

晴.zh: 如果明天晴，我们就去野餐。
晴.en: If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go on a picnic.
These days have been very sunny.

晴.zh: 虽然上午下雨了，但下午就晴了。
晴.en: Although it rained in the morning, it cleared up in the afternoon.

班长.en: The class monitor called us to a meeting.
The class monitor handed in my homework for me.

班长.zh: 我们班班长学习特别好。
班长.en: Our class monitor is really good at studying.

班长.zh: 因为班长有事，今天由我代班。
班长.en: Because the class monitor has something to do, I'm filling in today.

洗手间.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the restroom?

洗手间.zh: 如果找不到洗手间，可以问服务员。
洗手间.en: If you can't find the restroom, you can ask the staff.

日报.en: I read the daily newspaper every day.

日报.zh: 虽然现在都看手机新闻，但我还是喜欢订一份日报。
日报.en: Although everyone reads news on phones now, I still like subscribing to a daily newspaper.

日报.zh: 这份日报的体育版很有意思。
日报.en: The sports section of this daily newspaper is interesting.

日报.zh: 因为上班太忙，我只能周末翻翻日报。
日报.en: Because work is too busy, I can only flip through the daily newspaper on weekends.

日报.zh: 你明天记得帮我带一份日报。
日报.en: Remember to bring me a copy of the daily newspaper tomorrow.

开学.zh: 开学以后，我就没时间打游戏了。
开学.en: After school starts, I won't have time to play games.

开学.zh: 虽然不想开学，但还是要准备好书包。
开学.en: Although I don't want school to start, I still need to prepare my backpack.

开学.zh: 开学第一天老师就布置了很多作业。
开学.en: On the first day of school, the teacher assigned a lot of homework.

开学.zh: 你开学要买什么新文具？
开学.en: What new stationery do you need to buy for the start of school?

走进.zh: 我走进咖啡馆的时候，她已经在等我了。
走进.en: When I walked into the café, she was already waiting for me.

走进.zh: 因为他走得太快，我没看清他走进了哪栋楼。
走进.en: Because he walked too fast, I didn't see which building he walked into.

走进.zh: 走进公园，就能闻到花香。
走进.en: Walking into the park, you can smell the flowers.

走进.zh: 她紧张地走进面试房间。
走进.en: She nervously walked into the interview room.

体育场.zh: 我们约好在体育场门口见面。
体育场.en: We agreed to meet at the entrance of the stadium.

体育场.zh: 如果明天天气好，我们就去体育场跑步。
体育场.en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go running at the stadium.

体育场.zh: 这个体育场能容纳五万人。
晚上体育场的灯都亮了。
体育场.en: At night, the lights of the stadium are all on.

组长.en: The team leader is on leave today.

组长.zh: 我们组长做事很认真，大家都服他。
组长.en: Our team leader is very serious about work, everyone respects him.

组长.zh: 因为组长生病了，所以会议推迟了。
组长.en: Because the team leader is sick, the meeting was postponed.
Were you chosen as team leader?

组长.zh: 组长让我把这个文件交给经理。
组长.en: The team leader asked me to give this document to the manager.

个子.zh: 我弟弟虽然年纪小，但个子已经比我高了。
个子.en: Although my younger brother is young, he is already taller than me.

个子.zh: 因为个子太高，他买裤子总是很麻烦。
个子.en: Because he is too tall, buying pants is always troublesome for him.

个子.zh: 她个子不大，力气倒不小。
个子.en: She is not big in stature, but has a lot of strength.

个子.zh: 你们俩个子差不多，衣服可以换着穿。
个子.en: You two are about the same height, you can exchange clothes.

地铁站.en: The subway station is up ahead.

地铁站.zh: 我从地铁站出来，发现下雨了。
地铁站.en: When I came out of the subway station, I found it was raining.

地铁站.zh: 如果你不知道路，就坐地铁到西单站，那个地铁站很大。
地铁站.en: If you don't know the way, take the subway to Xidan station, that subway station is very big.

地铁站.zh: 这个地铁站有五个出口。
地铁站.en: This subway station has five exits.

地铁站.zh: 地铁站里人太多了，挤不上去。
地铁站.en: There are too many people in the subway station, I can't get on.

没意思.zh: 一个人待在家里看电视，真的很没意思。
没意思.en: Staying at home watching TV alone is really boring.

没意思.zh: 虽然大家都说好玩，但我去了觉得特别没意思。
没意思.en: Although everyone said it was fun, I went and found it very boring.
The more I read this book, the more boring it gets.

没意思.zh: 整天玩游戏也没意思，不如出去走走。
没意思.en: Playing games all day is also boring, might as well go out for a walk.

羊肉.zh: 冬天吃羊肉火锅最暖和了。
羊肉.en: Eating lamb hotpot in winter is the warmest.

羊肉.zh: 虽然羊肉有点膻，但烤着吃就很香。
羊肉.en: Although lamb has a gamey smell, it's very tasty when grilled.

羊肉.zh: 这家店的羊肉串味道正宗。
羊肉.en: The lamb skewers at this shop taste authentic.
Are you buying lamb or beef?

站住.zh: 小偷想跑，警察大喊了一声"站住"。
站住.en: The thief tried to run, the police shouted 'stop'.

站住.zh: 如果你不站住，我就开枪了。
站住.en: If you don't stop, I'll shoot.

站住.zh: 他站住脚步，回头看了看。
站住.en: He stopped in his tracks and looked back.
Don't go, stop and let me finish.

书包.zh: 我把书包放在椅子上，然后去吃饭了。
书包.en: I put my backpack on the chair and then went to eat.

书包.zh: 这个书包是妈妈给我买的生日礼物。
书包.en: This backpack is a birthday gift from my mom.

书包.zh: 因为书包里东西太多，所以拉链坏了。
书包.en: Because there are too many things in the backpack, the zipper broke.

书包.zh: 你记得把书包里的作业本拿出来。
书包.en: Remember to take your homework notebook out of the backpack.

本子.zh: 这个本子是我写日记用的，已经写了一半。
本子.en: This notebook is for my diary, I've already written half of it.

本子.zh: 如果你需要本子，可以去超市买。
本子.en: If you need a notebook, you can buy it at the supermarket.

本子.zh: 老师让我们把笔记写在本子上。
本子.en: The teacher told us to write notes in the notebook.

本子.zh: 我的本子用完了，明天得再买一个。
本子.en: I've used up my notebook, I have to buy another tomorrow.

公共汽车.en: I take the bus to work.

公共汽车.zh: 今天公共汽车特别挤，我等了三趟才上去。
公共汽车.en: Today the bus was very crowded; I waited for three buses before getting on.

公共汽车.zh: 虽然公共汽车慢一点，但是票价便宜。
公共汽车.en: Although the bus is a bit slower, the fare is cheap.

公共汽车.zh: 从学校到火车站可以坐公共汽车。
公共汽车.en: From school to the train station you can take the bus.

公共汽车.zh: 公共汽车站就在我家楼下，很方便。
公共汽车.en: The bus stop is right downstairs from my home, it's very convenient.

过年.en: Are you going home for the New Year?

过年.zh: 我们全家每年过年都聚在一起吃年夜饭。
过年.en: Our whole family gets together every New Year to have the reunion dinner.

过年.zh: 因为过年要放假，所以我提前买好了火车票。
过年.en: Because there's a holiday for the New Year, I bought my train ticket in advance.

过年.zh: 过年的时候，孩子们最喜欢收红包。
过年.en: During the New Year, children love receiving red envelopes the most.

过年.zh: 今年过年我打算去朋友家玩。
过年.en: This New Year, I plan to go to a friend's house to have fun.

拿出.zh: 他从书包里拿出一本书开始读。
拿出.en: He took a book out of his backpack and started reading.

拿出.zh: 如果你有什么问题，可以拿出笔记本来记一下。
拿出.en: If you have any questions, you can take out your notebook to write them down.

拿出.zh: 妈妈从冰箱里拿出了一些水果。
拿出.en: Mom took some fruit out of the fridge.

拿出.zh: 上课前，老师让我们拿出课本。
拿出.en: Before class, the teacher asked us to take out our textbooks.

晴天.zh: 晴天的时候，我喜欢去公园散步。
晴天.en: On sunny days, I like to go for a walk in the park.

晴天.zh: 虽然天气预报说是晴天，但下午突然下雨了。
晴天.en: Although the weather forecast said it would be sunny, it suddenly rained in the afternoon.

晴天.zh: 明天如果是晴天，我们就去海边玩。
晴天.en: If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach to play.

晴天.zh: 晴天出门要记得涂防晒霜。
晴天.en: When going out on a sunny day, remember to apply sunscreen.

全年.en: This shop is open all year round.

全年.zh: 我们公司全年都有空调，冬天不冷夏天不热。
全年.en: Our company has air conditioning all year, not cold in winter and not hot in summer.

全年.zh: 因为全年无休，所以他们很辛苦。
全年.en: Because they work all year without rest, they are very hardworking.

全年.zh: 海南全年气温都很高，适合过冬。
全年.en: Hainan's temperature is high all year, suitable for spending winter.

全年.zh: 全年最忙的时候是春节前后。
全年.en: The busiest time of the year is around the Spring Festival.

爬山.zh: 爬山的时候要带足够的水和食物。
爬山.en: When hiking, you need to bring enough water and food.

爬山.zh: 虽然爬山很累，但是山顶的风景很美。
爬山.en: Although hiking is tiring, the view from the top is beautiful.

爬山.zh: 他每个周末都去爬山锻炼身体。
爬山.en: He goes hiking every weekend to exercise.

爬山.zh: 我第一次爬山是跟爸爸一起去的。
爬山.en: My first time hiking was with my dad.

那会儿.en: At that time I was still young.

那会儿.zh: 那会儿我还在上大学，时间很多。
那会儿.en: At that time I was still in college and had a lot of free time.

那会儿.zh: 那会儿因为工作太忙，所以很少回家。
那会儿.en: At that time because work was too busy, I rarely went home.

那会儿.zh: 你记得那会儿我们经常一起打球吗？
那会儿.en: Do you remember that time we used to play ball together often?

那会儿.zh: 那会儿的手机还没有现在这么智能。
那会儿.en: The phones at that time were not as smart as now.

绿茶.en: I like to drink green tea.

绿茶.zh: 泡绿茶的水温不能太高，不然会苦。
绿茶.en: The water temperature for brewing green tea shouldn't be too high, otherwise it will be bitter.

绿茶.zh: 如果你觉得累，可以喝点绿茶提神。
绿茶.en: If you feel tired, you can drink some green tea to refresh yourself.

绿茶.zh: 这家店的绿茶蛋糕很好吃。
绿茶.en: The green tea cake at this shop is delicious.

绿茶.zh: 妈妈每天下午都会泡一杯绿茶。
绿茶.en: Mom makes a cup of green tea every afternoon.

打车.en: I take a taxi to work every day.
It's raining, let's take a taxi.

打车.zh: 昨天我打车花了很多钱。
打车.en: Yesterday I spent a lot of money on a taxi.

打车.zh: 如果太晚了，我就打车回家。
打车.en: If it's too late, I'll take a taxi home.

打车.zh: 他不想坐公交，所以直接打车去了机场。
打车.en: He didn't want to take the bus, so he went straight to the airport by taxi.

饭馆.en: The food at this restaurant is very tasty.

饭馆.zh: 我们晚上去饭馆吃饭吧。
饭馆.en: Let's go to a restaurant for dinner tonight.

饭馆.zh: 那家饭馆的生意一直很好。
饭馆.en: That restaurant's business has always been good.

饭馆.zh: 因为不想做饭，所以我们去了楼下的小饭馆。
饭馆.en: Because we didn't want to cook, we went to the small restaurant downstairs.

饭馆.zh: 她喜欢在饭馆里点很多菜，然后和朋友一起分享。
饭馆.en: She likes to order many dishes at the restaurant and then share them with friends.

球鞋.zh: 我买了一双白色的球鞋。
球鞋.en: I bought a pair of white sneakers.

球鞋.zh: 他的球鞋脏了，需要洗一洗。
球鞋.en: His sneakers are dirty and need to be washed.

球鞋.zh: 虽然球鞋有点贵，但是质量很好。
球鞋.en: Although the sneakers are a bit expensive, the quality is good.

球鞋.zh: 他穿着新球鞋去打球，结果把鞋弄坏了。
球鞋.en: He wore his new sneakers to play ball, and ended up ruining them.

交朋友.zh: 我喜欢和诚实的人交朋友。
交朋友.en: I like to make friends with honest people.

交朋友.zh: 刚来这个城市的时候，我很难交朋友。
交朋友.en: When I first came to this city, it was hard for me to make friends.

晚报.en: He reads the evening newspaper every day.

晚报.zh: 这份晚报的内容很丰富。
晚报.en: This evening newspaper has rich content.

晚报.zh: 我爸爸习惯在晚饭后看晚报。
晚报.en: My dad is used to reading the evening newspaper after dinner.

晚报.zh: 虽然现在手机上看新闻很方便，但他还是喜欢读晚报。
晚报.en: Although it's convenient to read news on the phone now, he still likes to read the evening newspaper.

晚报.zh: 晚报上登了一条关于附近公园改建的消息。
晚报.en: The evening newspaper published a piece of news about the renovation of the nearby park.

药水.en: This bottle of liquid medicine is very bitter.

药水.zh: 医生给我开了一种药水。
药水.en: The doctor prescribed a liquid medicine for me.
Shake it before drinking the liquid medicine.

药水.zh: 如果咳嗽的话，可以试试这种药水。
药水.en: If you have a cough, you can try this liquid medicine.

药水.zh: 他把药水倒进杯子里，然后一口喝完了。
药水.en: He poured the liquid medicine into a cup and then drank it all in one gulp.

女孩儿.zh: 女孩儿喜欢穿漂亮的裙子。
女孩儿.en: Girls like to wear beautiful dresses.

女孩儿.zh: 她是一个爱笑的女孩儿。
女孩儿.en: She is a girl who loves to smile.

女孩儿.zh: 昨天我在公园里看到一个女孩儿在画画。
女孩儿.en: Yesterday I saw a girl painting in the park.

女孩儿.zh: 这个女孩儿不但学习好，而且唱歌也很好听。
女孩儿.en: This girl not only studies well but also sings beautifully.

问路.en: I often need to ask for directions.
He asked an old man for directions.
You should be polite when asking for directions.

问路.zh: 因为迷路了，所以我只好找警察问路。
问路.en: Because I was lost, I had to ask a policeman for directions.

问路.zh: 他用手机地图问路，很快就找到了地方。
问路.en: He used his phone map to ask for directions and found the place quickly.

午睡.en: I take a half-hour nap every day.
Napping is good for your health.

午睡.zh: 他午睡的时候不喜欢被打扰。
午睡.en: He doesn't like to be disturbed when he naps.

午睡.zh: 如果中午不午睡，下午就会很困。
午睡.en: If I don't nap at noon, I'll be very sleepy in the afternoon.

午睡.zh: 她习惯在沙发上躺着午睡，这样比较舒服。
午睡.en: She is used to napping on the sofa because it's more comfortable.

药片.en: Take this pill three times a day.

药片.zh: 药片太大了，很难吞下去。
药片.en: The pill is too big to swallow.

药片.zh: 医生建议我饭后吃这些药片。
药片.en: The doctor advised me to take these pills after meals.

药片.zh: 虽然药片很苦，但是为了治病也要吃。
药片.en: Although the pills are bitter, you still need to take them to cure the disease.

药片.zh: 她把药片放在嘴里，然后喝了一口水咽了下去。
药片.en: She put the pill in her mouth, then took a sip of water and swallowed it.

奶茶.en: I want to drink milk tea.

奶茶.zh: 今天下午我们去买奶茶吧。
奶茶.en: This afternoon let's go buy milk tea.

奶茶.zh: 因为天气太热，所以我点了一杯冰奶茶。
奶茶.en: Because the weather is too hot, I ordered an iced milk tea.

奶茶.zh: 这家店的奶茶特别好喝。
奶茶.en: This shop's milk tea is especially delicious.

奶茶.zh: 每次逛街我都喜欢买一杯奶茶。
奶茶.en: Every time I go shopping I like to buy a cup of milk tea.

一点点.en: I only want a little bit of sugar.

一点点.zh: 请你再加一点点盐，味道会更好。
一点点.en: Please add a little bit more salt, the taste will be better.

一点点.zh: 虽然我只吃了一点点，但是已经饱了。
一点点.en: Although I only ate a little bit, I'm already full.

一点点.zh: 我对他只是有一点点喜欢。
一点点.en: I only like him a little bit.

一点点.zh: 这个菜辣了，我只吃了一点点。
一点点.en: This dish is spicy, I only ate a little bit.

红茶.en: I like to drink black tea.

红茶.zh: 这杯红茶是刚泡的，趁热喝吧。
红茶.en: This cup of black tea was just brewed, drink it while it's hot.

红茶.zh: 如果你不想喝咖啡，可以试试红茶。
红茶.en: If you don't want to drink coffee, you can try black tea.

红茶.zh: 我每天早上都要喝一杯红茶。
红茶.en: Every morning I drink a cup of black tea.

红茶.zh: 这家店的红茶味道很香。
红茶.en: This shop's black tea has a very fragrant taste.

春节.zh: 我们全家打算一起回老家过春节。
春节.en: Our whole family plans to go back to hometown for Spring Festival.

春节.zh: 虽然春节很热闹，但是我更喜欢在家休息。
春节.en: Although Spring Festival is very lively, I prefer to rest at home.

春节.zh: 春节的时候，大家都会放鞭炮。
春节.en: During Spring Festival, everyone sets off firecrackers.
This Spring Festival I'm going to travel.

阴天.zh: 阴天的时候，我总想睡觉。
阴天.en: On cloudy days, I always want to sleep.

阴天.zh: 因为明天是阴天，所以我不打算出门。
阴天.en: Because tomorrow is a cloudy day, I don't plan to go out.

阴天.zh: 虽然阴天没有太阳，但是不热。
阴天.en: Although it's cloudy without sun, it's not hot.

阴天.zh: 我最不喜欢阴天了，心情会不好。
阴天.en: I dislike cloudy days the most, my mood becomes bad.

西医.en: He went to see a Western doctor.

西医.zh: 我感冒的时候，更喜欢看西医。
西医.en: When I have a cold, I prefer to see a Western doctor.

西医.zh: 虽然中医也不错，但我还是相信西医。
西医.en: Although Chinese medicine is also good, I still trust Western medicine.

西医.zh: 西医的治疗方法通常比较快。
西医.en: Western medicine treatments are usually faster.

西医.zh: 这家医院既有中医也有西医。
西医.en: This hospital has both Chinese and Western medicine.

小孩儿.zh: 公园里有很多小孩儿在玩耍。
小孩儿.en: There are many children playing in the park.

小孩儿.zh: 虽然小孩儿喜欢吵闹，但是也很天真。
小孩儿.en: Although children like to be noisy, they are also innocent.
Her child is only two years old.

小孩儿.zh: 我小时候也是一个调皮的小孩儿。
小孩儿.en: When I was little, I was also a naughty child.

听讲.en: In class, you need to listen attentively.

听讲.zh: 他听讲的时候总是做笔记。
听讲.en: He always takes notes when listening to lectures.

听讲.zh: 因为昨天没听讲，所以我今天听不懂。
听讲.en: Because I didn't listen to the lecture yesterday, I can't understand today.

听讲.zh: 那个老师讲课很有趣，大家都喜欢听讲。
听讲.en: That teacher's lectures are very interesting, everyone likes to listen.

听讲.zh: 听讲的时候不要玩手机。
听讲.en: Don't play with your phone while listening to the lecture.

中小学.en: Primary and secondary schools are about to start.

中小学.zh: 我们市里的中小学最近都在装修。
中小学.en: The primary and secondary schools in our city are all under renovation recently.

中小学.zh: 虽然中小学很辛苦，但是很重要。
中小学.en: Although primary and secondary school is hard, it's very important.
He is a primary and secondary school teacher.

中小学.zh: 中小学的教育对孩子影响很大。
中小学.en: The education in primary and secondary school has a big influence on children.

一路平安.zh: 你要去很远的地方，一路平安！
一路平安.en: You're going to a faraway place, have a safe journey!

一路平安.zh: 虽然我很舍不得，但还是祝你一路平安。
一路平安.en: Although I'm reluctant, I still wish you a safe journey.

一路平安.zh: 每次朋友出门，我都会说一路平安。
一路平安.en: Every time a friend goes out, I say have a safe journey.

一路平安.zh: 妈妈送我到车站，对我说一路平安。
一路平安.en: Mom saw me off at the station and said have a safe journey.

不一会儿.en: He'll be back in a little while.

不一会儿.zh: 等了一会儿，不一会儿车就来了。
不一会儿.en: After waiting a bit, the bus came in no time.

不一会儿.zh: 天气太热，不一会儿我就出汗了。
不一会儿.en: The weather is so hot that I started sweating in no time.

不一会儿.zh: 他跑得很快，不一会儿就到了学校。
不一会儿.en: He runs very fast, and he arrived at school in no time.

不一会儿.zh: 你在这儿坐一会儿，不一会儿饭就好了。
不一会儿.en: Sit here for a while, and the food will be ready soon.

不太.zh: 我今天不太舒服，想休息一下。
不太.en: I'm not feeling very well today, I want to rest a bit.

不太.zh: 他说话不太清楚，我听不太懂。
不太.en: He doesn't speak very clearly, so I can't understand him very well.

不太.zh: 这件衣服样子不错，就是颜色不太喜欢。
不太.en: This clothes looks nice, but I don't really like the color.

不太.zh: 虽然天气不太好，但是我们还是去了公园。
不太.en: Although the weather wasn't very good, we still went to the park.

生词.en: How many new words did you learn today?

生词.zh: 这些生词太难了，我记不住。
生词.en: These new words are too hard; I can't remember them.

生词.zh: 老师让我们把生词抄写三遍。
生词.en: The teacher asked us to copy the new words three times.

生词.zh: 你先读一遍课文，然后找出不认识的生词。
生词.en: Read the text once first, then find the new words you don't know.

生词.zh: 我用手机查生词，但是查完就忘了。
生词.en: I look up new words on my phone, but I forget them right after.

画儿.zh: 她喜欢画儿，每周都去美术馆。
画儿.en: She likes paintings, and she goes to the art museum every week.

画儿.zh: 小孩子画的画儿虽然简单，但是很有意思。
画儿.en: The paintings children draw are simple, but very interesting.

画儿.zh: 你墙上挂的那张画儿是在哪儿买的？
画儿.en: Where did you buy that painting hanging on your wall?

画儿.zh: 他画了一幅画儿送给我，我很喜欢。
画儿.en: He painted a picture and gave it to me, and I really like it.

打篮球.zh: 他每天下午都去打篮球。
打篮球.en: He goes to play basketball every afternoon.

打篮球.zh: 打篮球可以锻炼身体，还能交朋友。
打篮球.en: Playing basketball can exercise the body and also make friends.

打篮球.zh: 周末的时候，我经常和同学在操场打篮球。
打篮球.en: On weekends, I often play basketball with classmates on the playground.

打篮球.zh: 他虽然个子不高，但是打篮球打得特别好。
打篮球.en: Although he's not tall, he plays basketball very well.

公交车.en: The bus is coming, get on quickly!
I take the bus to work every day.

公交车.zh: 这路公交车可以到火车站吗？
公交车.en: Does this bus go to the train station?

公交车.zh: 今天公交车特别挤，我等了三辆才上去。
公交车.en: The bus was so crowded today that I waited for three before I could get on.

公交车.zh: 坐公交车比打车便宜，但是花的时间长一些。
公交车.en: Taking the bus is cheaper than taking a taxi, but it takes longer.

见过.zh: 这么漂亮的花我还是第一次见过。
见过.en: This is my first time seeing such beautiful flowers.

见过.zh: 我好像在哪儿见过你，但是想不起来了。
见过.en: I feel like I've seen you somewhere, but I can't remember.

见过.zh: 虽然我们没见过面，但是我已经知道你是谁了。
见过.en: Although we haven't met face to face, I already know who you are.

快点儿.en: Hurry up, we're going to be late!

快点儿.zh: 你吃饭快点儿，别慢慢吞吞的。
快点儿.en: Eat a bit faster, don't dawdle.

快点儿.zh: 快点儿写作业，写完就可以看电视了。
快点儿.en: Hurry up and finish your homework, then you can watch TV.

快点儿.zh: 他让我快点儿走，说电影马上开始了。
快点儿.en: He told me to walk faster, saying the movie is about to start.

快点儿.zh: 你说话快点儿，我没时间听你慢慢说。
快点儿.en: Speak a bit faster, I don't have time to listen to you slowly.

那时候.en: I was young then and didn't understand things.

那时候.zh: 那时候没有手机，大家都写信。
那时候.en: Back then there were no cell phones; everyone wrote letters.

那时候.zh: 我们那时候是同学，现在还是好朋友。
那时候.en: We were classmates back then, and we're still good friends now.

那时候.zh: 那时候的日子虽然苦，但是很快乐。
那时候.en: Life back then was hard, but it was happy.

那时候.zh: 你那时候为什么不告诉我真相呢？
那时候.en: Why didn't you tell me the truth back then?

男孩儿.en: That boy is my younger brother.

男孩儿.zh: 这个男孩儿很喜欢踢足球。
男孩儿.en: This boy really likes playing soccer.

男孩儿.zh: 邻居家的男孩儿今年上小学了。
男孩儿.en: The boy next door started elementary school this year.

男孩儿.zh: 她生了一个男孩儿，全家都很高兴。
男孩儿.en: She gave birth to a boy, and the whole family was very happy.

男孩儿.zh: 那个穿红衣服的男孩儿是班上最高的。
男孩儿.en: That boy in red clothes is the tallest in the class.

挺好.zh: 这个电影挺好，我推荐你看。
挺好.en: This movie is pretty good, I recommend you watch it.

挺好.zh: 虽然有点贵，但质量挺好。
挺好.en: Although a bit expensive, the quality is quite good.

挺好.zh: 最近身体挺好，就是有点累。
挺好.en: Recently my health is quite good, just a bit tired.

下周.zh: 下周我们一起去爬山吧。
下周.en: Let's go hiking together next week.

下周.zh: 考试在下周一，你准备好了吗？
下周.en: The exam is next Monday, are you ready?
I'll go to Beijing for a business trip next week.
Can you come to the party next week?

下周.zh: 如果下周不下雨，我们就去野餐。
下周.en: If it doesn't rain next week, we'll go for a picnic.

笑话儿.zh: 他讲了一个笑话儿，大家都笑了。
笑话儿.en: He told a joke, everyone laughed.

笑话儿.zh: 这个笑话儿一点都不好笑。
笑话儿.en: This joke is not funny at all.
Don't tell that old joke anymore.

笑话儿.zh: 我喜欢听相声里的笑话儿。
笑话儿.en: I like listening to jokes in cross talk.

笑话儿.zh: 你每次讲笑话儿都把自己逗笑。
笑话儿.en: Every time you tell a joke, you make yourself laugh.

有一点儿.zh: 这个菜有一点儿辣，你能吃吗？
有一点儿.en: This dish is a little spicy, can you eat it?

有一点儿.zh: 今天有一点儿冷，多穿点衣服。
有一点儿.en: It's a little cold today, wear more clothes.

有一点儿.zh: 我有一点儿担心明天的考试。
有一点儿.en: I'm a little worried about tomorrow's exam.

有空儿.en: When you have time, come often to play.

有空儿.zh: 等你有空儿，我们聊聊天。
有空儿.en: When you have time, let's chat.

有空儿.zh: 如果有空儿，帮我买杯咖啡。
有空儿.en: If you have time, help me buy a cup of coffee.
